input_projection.rule: Apply candidate energetics only as an external sensitivity overlay; never rewrite source-data nulls or emit canonical rows.

machine_readable_event_energy_anchors.rule: Use final finite diagnostic explosion energies only as model-specific sensitivity anchors. Do not interpolate across the ECSN/Fe-core or solar/zero-metallicity model boundaries and do not replace NuGrid source nulls.

machine_readable_mass_grid_energy_anchor.rule: Use P-HOTB final kinetic energies, fallback, and baryonic mass cuts only as source-grid sensitivity anchors. Do not infer exact ejecta launch momentum from the rounded stable plus selected-radioactive tables, do not interpolate across engines or metallicity, and do not replace NuGrid source nulls.

source_table_ultralowz_energy_anchors.rule: Use the exact article-source Table 7 thermal-bomb kinetic energies and remnant masses only as sparse sensitivity anchors. Do not infer ejecta launch momentum because wind/terminal ownership is unresolved, do not interpolate in mass/metallicity/rotation, and keep 025z600 quarantined.

source_table_popiii_energy_grid.rule: Retain kinetic energy at infinity, piston location, artificial mixing, and fallback as a coupled review grid. Do not select a population distribution, infer exact remnant mass from listed-isotope residuals, derive launch momentum, or interpolate/extrapolate in mass or metallicity.

source_frame_momentum.canonical_quantity: cumulative net directed momentum vector in the stellar comoving frame
source_frame_momentum.bulk_advective_momentum: added separately by the RAMSES runtime as returned_mass times particle velocity
source_frame_momentum.scalar_radial_momentum: separate non-negative deposition budget; not representable by choosing an arbitrary Cartesian vector direction

1.name: massive_star_wind
1.limitation: A single terminal velocity applied to terminal-lumped wind mass is not an age-, phase-, mass-, or metallicity-resolved wind model.

2.name: AGB_wind
2.limitation: The velocity grid is a sensitivity bracket, not a source-specific dust-driven wind prescription.

3.name: core_collapse_supernova
3.limitation: The NuGrid yields do not supply an explosion energy/failure flag; the energy grid is not coupled to progenitor compactness, fallback, or remnant outcome, and the terminal-shell fit is audited only at its published 1e51 erg calibration.

literature_evidence.use: Empirical O/B-star samples contain terminal velocities around 1000--2300 km/s; 3000 km/s is retained as an upper sensitivity node, not an adopted population prescription.
Published AGB outflow velocities motivate a 5--30 km/s sensitivity bracket; no universal fixed value is approved.
Explosion outcome and kinetic energy vary non-monotonically with progenitor structure; a fixed 1e51 erg event cannot be inferred from the yield mass alone.

literature_evidence.quantity: machine-readable low-mass CCSN diagnostic energy anchors
literature_evidence.use: The e8.8, s9.0, and z9.6 machine-readable diagnostic-energy series provide discrete sub-1e50 erg model anchors; their heterogeneous progenitors forbid interpolation into a universal mass-energy relation.

literature_evidence.quantity: machine-readable solar 9--12 Msun final kinetic-energy grid
literature_evidence.use: The Z9.6 P-HOTB release supplies progenitor-specific final kinetic energy, fallback, and baryonic mass cut at 13 solar-metallicity nodes from 9--12 Msun. It is retained as a single-engine sensitivity grid, not a universal or canonical prescription.

literature_evidence.quantity: source-table zero and ultra-low-Z thermal-bomb energy anchors
literature_evidence.use: Article-source Table 7 supplies 34 kinetic-energy and remnant-mass records at 15 and 25 Msun over Z=0--3.236e-6 and multiple rotations. The thermal-bomb/fixed-Ni56-mass-cut values are sparse sensitivity anchors, not an approved neutrino-driven or interpolable population model.

literature_evidence.quantity: official electronic Pop III piston-energy grid
literature_evidence.use: VizieR Table 8 supplies kinetic energy at infinity over 120 zero-metallicity masses, two piston definitions, and four artificial-mixing settings. It is retained as a coupled sensitivity grid, not an approved event-energy population model.
Audit the published 2.8e5 Msun km/s n^-0.17 terminal radial-momentum fit over n=0.1--100 cm^-3; this scalar is not a canonical net vector.

required_before_approval: Select and cite a progenitor-, metallicity-, remnant-, and fallback-consistent energy model.
Select age-resolved wind and AGB velocity or mechanical-luminosity histories.
Define the resolution- and environment-dependent thermal versus terminal-radial-momentum deposition switch.
Validate conservation and convergence in resolved and unresolved blast/wind tests.
